text.title: Writing Implementation Plans Worked Example
text.summary: End-to-end worked example showing inputs → procedure → output for a typical instance of Writing Implementation Plans, plus a fully specified task and a wave table with critical path.

example.scenario: F-066 plan: 100 methodology rows, est_tokens 80k each, grouped into 5 waves of 20, total 8M tokens within 10M cap. Every row references AD-1 (v3 schema) and AC = 'all six validators green'.

example.title: Fully specified task with tier, traces, dependencies and verifiable AC
example.code:
### TASK-003: Create user authentication middleware
- **Complexity:** Normal - **Tokens:** ~45k - **AD-X:** AD-002 - **FR-X:** FR-005, FR-006 - **Depends on:** TASK-001 (user model), TASK-002 (JWT utility) - **Blocks:** TASK-005 (protected routes)
**Files:** - CREATE `src/middleware/auth.py` - MODIFY `src/app.py` — register middleware
**Acceptance Criteria:** 1. Given valid JWT, when request arrives, then `request.user` is populated. 2. Given expired JWT, when request arrives, then 401 response is returned. 3. Given missing Authorization header, then 401 is returned.
example.note: Satisfies r-invest, r-token-budget-tiers (Normal tier), r3-trace-to-design and r4-ac-per-task.
